audit.whatIsWrong: The entire entry is built around an ability called 'Repeating Dashes', which Ambessa does not have, and never states the one interaction that decides the matchup.
audit.why: Her abilities are Drakehound's Step, Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, Repudiation, Lacerate and Public Execution. Public Execution suppresses on arrival then stuns — Behind Enemy Lines is a channel, so that suppress ends it outright. Nothing on the page said so.

notes: The name 'Repeating Dashes' is fabricated and still appears in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.early/mid/spikes/feeding/difficulty/trading, dosFull[2].d, report[1].t, report[9].t, report[10].t and report[12].t. focus.text ('Ambessa Repeating Dashes') is 24 characters, so the applier's under-25 skip would drop an edit there — the focus target needs to be re-set by the user or by a tool pass, ideally to 'Ambessa Public Execution'.
